    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # Fill enclosed rectangular outline interiors; preserve the outlines.
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)

    # Find bounding boxes of each non-background color and fill their interior.
    for color in set(v for row in g for v in row if v!=background):

        r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)
        c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
        if r1-r0>=2 and c1-c0>=2:
            # A complete perimeter marks a hollow object.
            if (all(g[r0][c]==color for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and
                all(g[r1][c]==color for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and
                all(g[r][c0]==color and g[r][c1]==color for r in range(r0,r1+1))):
                for r in range(r0+1,r1):

'''

code='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # Mark background regions enclosed by a colored outline and fill them.
    seen=set()
    for r0 in range(h):
        for c0 in range(w):
            if g[r0][c0]!=bg or (r0,c0) in seen: continue
            q=deque([(r0,c0)]); seen.add((r0,c0)); cells=[]; edge=False
            while q:
                r,c=q.popleft(); cells.append((r,c))
                if r in (0,h-1) or c in (0,w-1): edge=True
                for nr,nc in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                    if 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w and g[nr][nc]==bg and (nr,nc) not in seen:
                        seen.add((nr,nc)); q.append((nr,nc))
            if not edge:
                # Odd-sided square cavities use 7; other cavities use 2.
                rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
                hh=max(rs)-min(rs)+1; ww=max(cs)-min(cs)+1
                fill=7 if hh==ww and hh%2==1 else 2
                for r,c in cells: g[r][c]=fill
    # A solid 3x3 colored marker also has its center changed to 7.
    for r in range(h-2):
        for c in range(w-2):
            vals=[g[rr][cc] for rr in range(r,r+3) for cc in range(c,c+3)]
            if len(set(vals))==1 and vals[0]!=bg:
                g[r+1][c+1]=7
    return g
'''
